selected_evidence.requirement: RabbitMQ installed and joined into a single cluster across node1, node2, node3
selected_evidence.summary: All three nodes started RabbitMQ; node2 and node3 successfully joined node1's cluster; cluster_status from node1 shows all three as Disk Nodes and Running Nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: `payments` vhost created with an application account (app_user) able to publish/consume
selected_evidence.summary: payments vhost and app_user created with full configure/write/read permissions scoped to payments; password subsequently rotated via secret_env.

selected_evidence.requirement: Durable queue created, replicated across all nodes
selected_evidence.summary: Quorum queue `orders` declared durable in payments vhost with members [rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3], online on all three.

selected_evidence.requirement: Messages survive the loss of one node and stay consumable from remaining nodes
selected_evidence.summary: 3 durable messages published via node1; node2's rabbitmq-server stopped; cluster_status confirmed quorum (node1+node3) preserved and queue still held 3 messages; all 3 messages consumed successfully from node3 while node2 was down; a 4th message published during the outage also succeeded; node2 restarted and rejoined; remaining message consumed, queue confirmed empty/healthy afterward.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/queue state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 06660b56... captured with healthy 3-node cluster; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id dec5be28... (changed) confirmed via exec repoll; rabbitmq-server auto-started, rejoined cluster (all 3 running); publish+consume succeeded through node1 post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/queue state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 53c8268a... captured with healthy 3-node cluster; reboot issued; quorum (node1+node3) confirmed preserved during outage; post-reboot boot_id 9fc91337... (changed) confirmed; rabbitmq-server auto-started, rejoined cluster; publish+consume succeeded through node2 post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/queue state

(changed) confirmed; rabbitmq-server auto-started, rejoined cluster; publish+consume succeeded through node3 post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster and cross-node functional verification after all three restarts
selected_evidence.summary: node2's cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running; node1 net_adm:ping to node3 returns pong; queue Raft members list all 3 nodes with online leader on node2; a message published from node1 was successfully consumed from node3, confirming end-to-end cross-node durability and consumability post-restart.

commands.command:
cat > /tmp/publish.py <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
import pika, os, sys

host = sys.argv[1]
pw = os.environ["APP_PW"]
msg = sys.argv[2]

creds = pika.PlainCredentials("app_user", pw)
params = pika.ConnectionParameters(host=host, virtual_host="payments", credentials=creds)
conn = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
ch = conn.channel()
ch.queue_declare(queue="orders", durable=True, arguments={"x-queue-type": "quorum"})
ch.basic_publish(
    exchange="",
    routing_key="orders",
    body=msg,
    properties=pika.BasicProperties(delivery_mode=2),
)
print("published:", msg)
conn.close()
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /tmp/consume.py <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
import pika, os, sys

host = sys.argv[1]
pw = os.environ["APP_PW"]
count = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 10

creds = pika.PlainCredentials("app_user", pw)
params = pika.ConnectionParameters(host=host, virtual_host="payments", credentials=creds)
conn = pika.BlockingConnection(params)
ch = conn.channel()
got = 0
while got < count:
    method, props, body = ch.basic_get(queue="orders", auto_ack=True)
    if method is None:
        break
    print("consumed:", body.decode())
    got += 1
print("total_consumed:", got)
conn.close()
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo done
